core_obligations: Descend to the affine case and express geometric reducedness of the fibre by a condition on a finitely presented algebra.
Apply the constructibility criterion for finitely presented morphisms.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the affine situation over the base.
Encode geometric reducedness as a finite-presentation condition.

difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact morphism locally of finite presentation, the locus of points of the base whose fibre is geometrically reduced is shown to be locally constructible. The proof descends to the affine case, expresses geometric reducedness of the fibre by the absence of nilpotents in a finitely presented algebra after base change to the algebraic closure, and then applies the constructibility of such conditions for finitely presented morphisms. Encoding geometric reducedness as a finite-presentation condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7268-7302.
